recentItems.title: Asikhulume | Coalition government and your vote
recentItems.description:
Njengoba sisondela okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwangomhlaka-4 kuNovemba 2026 sibheka ohulumeni bobumbano osekuyinsakavukela eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuye kwaholela ekushintsheni kokungazinzi kwezepolitiki, kanye nokwehla kokulethwa kwezinsiza nokunye. 

Sibuza ukuthi , abavoti balibamba kanjani iqembu abalivotele ukuba  liziphendulele uma lilahla izithembiso zalo zomkhankaso zokuqinisekisa isivumelwano? Abavoti benzenjani  lapho iqembu abalivotele lakha ubumbano nalelo abebengalivotelanga noma abahambisani nalo? 

Ingabe abavoti bangashintsha ukuziphatha kwabo uma amaqembu ephoqelekile ngokomthetho ukumemezela abalingani bawo abawathandayo obumbano ngaphambi kokhetho? Sikhuluma ngaloku nokunye no no Mbali Ntuli ongumsunguli wenhlangano i- Groundworks Collective kanye noSolwazi u Zwelinzima Ndevu, uchwepheshe wokubusa kwendawo.
